topic: The Magic of Pure Fourier Series: Breaking Down Waves

sections.title: Prerequisites & Intuition (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: Any complex wave is a sum of simple pieces.
Like vectors, we decompose signals into basic parts.
Think of a chord resolved into individual notes.
animations: Display text: Introduction to Fourier Series. Color: #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/piano.svg]
Show a simple wave function appearing. Color: #00FF00.
Morph the wave function into a sum of sines. Color: #FF00FF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/harp.svg]

sections.title: Defining the Pure Fourier Series (0:45-1:45)
lecture_lines: The series formula represents a signal's structure.
The constant term is the average height.
Summing sine waves creates complex oscillations.
animations: Display the general formula for Fourier Series. Color: #FFFFFF.
Label the constants a0, an, bn clearly. Color: #00FFFF.

sections.title: Calculating Coefficients (1:45-3:15)
lecture_lines: We use integrals to extract specific weights.
The overlap measures how much frequency exists.
Think of a filter tuning to a frequency.
animations: Display the integral formula for calculating coefficients. Color: #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/radio.svg]
Show the projection of the signal onto sine basis. Color: #FF0000.
Display the resulting coefficient value changing. Color: #00FF00. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/filter.svg]

sections.title: Visual Synthesis & Application (3:15-4:30)
lecture_lines: Building a square wave reveals hidden complexity.
Stacking waves makes the shape sharper.
More frequencies lead to better approximations.
animations: Show three sine waves stacking together using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/oscillator.svg] as the source. Color: #FF00FF.
Demonstrate the emergence of a square wave. Color: #00FFFF.
Highlight the convergence at discontinuities to produce an output signal via [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speaker.svg]. Color: #FFFF00.

sections.title: Summary & Wrap-up (4:30-5:00)
lecture_lines: Fourier series maps signals to frequency coefficients.
This is vital for MP3s and images.
Our ears use this to interpret sound.
